rows: See what Usha Amagothu from MBBS (2021) has to say about admission in KMC Warangal. In her words, “Eligibility is based on the cut-off. And the toughness of the paper. After the first counselling, the respected college asks us to submit the certificates regarding the exams. They give us particular dates to submit these certificates. To download the application form for the first counseling, they charge us 10000. If we are not satisfied with the college, we can wait for the second counselling. In a reservation, students do not need to pay more fees than general students. It also includes hostel fee, college fee, and library fee. The difficulty level has changed over the past few years. Actually, the level has decreased compared to previous years. The pattern also changed when our batch attempted NEET. They included an extra 20 questions, but the drawback is that they did not give extra time to solve those questions. Now it has been changed, and students have been given half an hour extra for the extra 20 questions. The exam is generally conducted once a year.
